user.title: Crestron CIP
user.description: Connect to a Crestron control processor over CIP. The integration registers as a device at the given IPID (use a spare IPID slot in the processor's program).

data.name: Name
data.project_file: Project file (optional): path to a .c3p or panel .zip to name joins and create buttons

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect / register with the processor. Check host, port, TLS, and that the IPID is defined and free in the program.
error.bad_project: Could not read a join map from that file. Give a path to a .c3p or a panel .zip that contains swf/Environment.xml.
error.panel_outside: That path is outside the config, share and media folders.
error.panel_unreadable: That file is not a panel project this can draw: no control in it binds a join.

abort.already_configured: This host + IPID is already configured.

init.title: Panel
init.description: Give this processor its touch panel: the panel's own .zip (or .c3p) from VTPro-e. It is imported for the Crestron XPanel card, which then needs only this processor's device. Current panel: {current}.

data.panel_path: Or a path to a file already on Home Assistant (/share, /media or the config folder)

error.panel_outside: That path is outside the config, share and media folders.
error.panel_unreadable: That file is not a panel project this can draw: no control in it binds a join.
